boundaries: Product Capability states the durable outcome promised; Implementation supplies technical realization; the Binding owns their lifecycle-bearing association.
The Binding is canonical for specialized realization state and may project one digest-bound Typed Relation.
Changing either endpoint or adoption posture creates a successor Binding revision.
claim_ceiling: This candidate defines Capability Realization Binding for Step 3 review only and has no admission or downstream activation effect.
residue_refs: Artifact Type rebinding and admission remain separate.

scope.applicability: A Capability Realization Binding is a lifecycle-bearing canonical association between one exact Product Capability revision and one or more exact Implementation revisions, with realization role, adoption posture, compatibility, conformance evidence, deployment applicability, owner, succession, and challenge handling.
exclusions: It is neither the Product Capability nor an Implementation and does not prove adoption, deployment, conformance, successful operation, or Product value.
A generic Typed Relation projection cannot become a second writable authority for the same binding.
This Definition does not admit a carrier, instance, relation, runtime, consumer, publication, or deployment.
